sentences.text:
Mr. S.N. Sukul, Adv.
...for the petitioner.

Mr. Rudradipta Nandy, Adv.
Ms. Sonali Das, Adv.
...for the State.
The instant revision is listed upon an application filed by the State of West Bengal.
This Court at the time of admission passed an order directing the police authority to investigate into the case.
The police authority was restrained from filing charge without the leave of the Court.
It is submitted on behalf of the State that the charge-sheet is ready and prosecution may be permitted to file charge sheet in the instant case.
The learned Advocate for the petitioner, on the other hand, has raised objection on the ground that if charge sheet is filed, then the instant revision becomes infractuous.

Having heard the learned Advocates for the parties, this Court is of the view that when the entire investigational process is assailed in the instant revision and the petitioner has prayed for quashing of the criminal proceedings, the documents which the accused/petitioner would receive under Section 207 of the Code of Criminal Procedure will not only the benefit of the petitioner but also beneficial to the Court to ascertain as to whether there is any ingredient in support of the charge Shah Alam Sarkar @ Saha Alam Sarkar vs State Of West Bengal & Anr on 19 May, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/115346094/
1 under Sections 376/506/34 of the Indian Penal Code.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: In view of such circumstances, the prosecution is permitted to file charge-sheet.

The learned Chief Judicial Magistrate, Murshidabad, Berhampore is directed to serve the copies under Section 207 of the Code of Criminal Procedure immediately to the accused persons but will not commit the case to the Court of Sessions till the disposal of the instant revision.
CRAN 1 of 2023 is, thus, disposed of.

( Bibek Chaudhuri, J. )
